title: Paper boat with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Water -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='42' ry='8' fill='#2E86C1'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#5DADE2'/>
  
  <!-- Boat hull - folded paper look -->
  <polygon points='50,45 15,72 85,72' fill='#F7F9F9'/>
  <polygon points='50,45 15,72 50,72' fill='#EAECEE'/>
  <polygon points='50,45 50,72 85,72' fill='#D5D8DC'/>
  
  <!-- Sail / top fold -->
  <polygon points='50,20 50,45 20,45' fill='#FDFEFE'/>
  <polygon points='50,20 50,45 80,45' fill='#E5E8E8'/>
  
  <!-- Paper fold lines -->
  <line x1='50' y1='20' x2='50' y2='72' stroke='#D5D8DC' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='20' y1='45' x2='50' y2='45' stroke='#D5D8DC' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='45' x2='80' y2='45' stroke='#D5D8DC' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Smiling face on the hull -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='58' r='3' fill='#1A5276'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='58' r='3' fill='#1A5276'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='57' r='1' fill='#AED6F1'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='57' r='1' fill='#AED6F1'/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M40,65 Q50,76 60,65' stroke='#1A5276' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='64' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#F5B7B1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='64' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#F5B7B1' opacity='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- Little wave lines -->
  <path d='M8,80 Q14,76 20,80' stroke='#85C1E9' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M25,85 Q31,81 37,85' stroke='#85C1E9' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M63,85 Q69,81 75,85' stroke='#85C1E9' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78,80 Q84,76 90,80' stroke='#85C1E9' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Small sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#F9E79F'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#F9E79F'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='42' r='1' fill='#F9E79F'/>
</svg>
